attempts.reason: Source already uses the HIP runtime API throughout (hipMalloc/hipMemcpy/hipFree/hipGetLastError/hipDeviceSynchronize) with HIP headers, so the CUDA-to-HIP translation is essentially complete. Changes made: replaced the residual CUDA-only triple-chevron launch with hipLaunchKernelGGL for portability across HIP launch paths, corrected the misleading 'cuda*' operation labels and the stale comment about staging x in device_output to reflect the actual two-buffer in-place scheme. Semantics, C ABI, error handling, buffer counts, block sizing, float32 precision, and in-place axpy behavior are preserved; the block-boundary guard (i < n) and zero-length early return remain, and all owned allocations are released on every path. Validation on the target GPU remains with the host runner.
